subject: [PATCH v4 11/13] mm/collapse: work out the orders a VMA allows once per VMA

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the way the kernel handles memory collapsing by allowing it to work out the allowed orders for a VMA only once per VMA, rather than once per PTE table. This is done by passing the mask of allowed orders from collapse_possible_orders() directly to the functions that need it, and sampling it once per VMA instead of once per table. The patch also ensures that changes to hugepage_vma_revalidate() are properly handled under the lock that produced the mask.
